capabilities: Render fenced code blocks as diagrams via a Kroki server
Load diagram source from a file in the vault
Configure the server URL, per-type code-block names, and per-type headers
Download diagrams as PNG or open them in niolesk
extras: Mermaid and PlantUML types ship disabled to avoid clashing with Obsidian's built-in Mermaid and the PlantUML plugin; diagrams.net requires a self-hosted Kroki with a companion container.
intentEvidence: a modified and slightly expanded version of the obsidian-plantuml plugin
problem: Obsidian only renders Mermaid natively, so diagrams written in PlantUML, GraphViz, D2 and other languages cannot be previewed inside notes.

relations.evidence: a modified and slightly expanded version of the obsidian-plantuml plugin by Johannes Theiner
This plugin uses, by default, the Kroki server for rendering

requires.name: Kroki server (public instance by default; self-hosted needed for diagrams.net and some other companion-service types)

summary: Kroki-based diagram renderer that turns fenced code blocks into SVG or image diagrams for many diagram languages via a Kroki server.
